title: Generic Webhook Relay
summary: Verify any signed incoming webhook, reshape it, and forward it to a downstream service with retries.

secrets.name: INBOUND_HMAC_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret the sender uses to sign webhook bodies.

secrets.name: RELAY_TARGET_URL
secrets.description: Downstream URL to POST the transformed event to.

secrets.name: DOWNSTREAM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bearer token for the downstream service.

setup: Edit steps/transform.ts to reshape the payload the way the downstream service expects.
Publish and point the sender's webhook at the URL shown in Studio.
